meta.name: Report post-deploy visual regressions with Snapshot Site, Slack, and GitHub

name: Post-Deploy Visual Smoke Test → Slack + GitHub Issue

parameters.content:
## Post-Deploy Visual Smoke Test → Slack + GitHub Issue

### How it works

Your CI pipeline calls this workflow's webhook right after a deploy finishes, POSTing the deployed page's URL, a baseline image/URL to compare against, and (optionally) the commit SHA and environment name. The workflow waits 45 seconds so CDN caches, edge revalidation and client-side hydration settle, then runs one Snapshot Site **Compare** call (baseline vs. freshly deployed page). Soft API errors are caught first, then the pixel mismatch is checked against a 10% layout-drift threshold. A regression fans out to two places at once: a Slack alert with the commit, environment, mismatch score and diff/before/after links, and a GitHub issue so the failure lands in the team's tracker instead of scrolling out of a channel. A clean deploy ends quietly on the No-Op branch.

### Setup steps

- Install the `n8n-nodes-snapshot-site` community node (Settings → Community nodes → Install → `n8n-nodes-snapshot-site`) — verified by n8n.
- Add a Snapshot Site credential, a Slack credential, and a GitHub credential (personal access token with `repo` scope).
- Open **Create Visual Regression Issue on GitHub** and set the repository owner and repository name.
- Activate the workflow, copy the Webhook node's **Production URL**, and call it from the last step of your deploy job with `{"url": "https://...", "baselineUrl": "https://...", "commit": "$GITHUB_SHA", "environment": "production"}`.
- `url` and `baselineUrl` must be full URLs including `https://` — the API rejects bare domains with a soft error (HTTP 200 + `{error: true, message}`), which this workflow routes to the failure alert.
- Tune the Wait node (30–60s is typical) and the mismatch percentage in **Check for Layout Regression** to your stack.

### Customization

The two knobs that matter are the settle delay and the mismatch threshold: `10` is a layout-drift band, `> 0` catches character-level text changes (pricing/legal copy), `~30` is defacement-level. Mask genuinely dynamic regions with `hide` (a comma-separated CSS selector string) in `afterOptions` instead of raising the threshold. Swap the GitHub node for Jira/Linear, or drop it and keep Slack only, if your team tracks regressions elsewhere.

## Receive deploy and compare

CI calls the webhook when a deploy finishes. The Wait node lets CDN caches and hydration settle before capture — skipping it is the #1 source of false-positive regressions.

## Handle compare errors

Catches hard failures (network/HTTP after 3 retries) on the node's error output and soft errors (HTTP 200 + `{error: true}`) on the success output, and sends both to one Slack failure alert.

## Report regression result

Evaluates the mismatch percentage against the 10% layout-drift threshold. A regression alerts Slack **and** files a GitHub issue in parallel; a clean deploy ends on the No-Op branch.

parameters.body:
=A post-deploy visual smoke test detected a layout regression.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Environment | `{{ $('When a Deploy Finishes').first().json.body.environment || 'production' }}` |
| Commit | `{{ $('When a Deploy Finishes').first().json.body.commit || 'unknown' }}` |
| Deployed URL | {{ $json.after.source }} |
| Baseline | {{ $json.before.source }} |
| Mismatch | **{{ $json.summary.mismatchPercentage }}%** ({{ $json.summary.mismatchPixels }} of {{ $json.summary.totalPixels }} px) |
| Same dimensions | {{ $json.summary.sameDimensions }} |

### Captures

- [Diff image]({{ $json.diff.link }})
- [Baseline capture]({{ $json.before.link }})
- [Deployed capture]({{ $json.after.link }})

![Visual diff]({{ $json.diff.link }})

_Filed automatically by the n8n post-deploy visual smoke test (Snapshot Site Compare)._
